import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"instruction\":{\"number\":1,\"title\":\"Fix this thing\",\"status\":\"draft\",\"instruction_type_id\":1,\"instruction_from_id\":1,\"date_received\":\"2016-10-13\",\"schedule_impact\":{\"status\":\"yes_known\",\"value\":14},\"cost_impact\":{\"status\":\"yes_known\",\"value\":12039.55},\"private\":false,\"description\":\"This is a description\",\"attention_ids\":[0],\"distribution_member_ids\":[0],\"trade_ids\":[0],\"attachments\":[\"string\"],\"upload_ids\":[\"1ZE146W9K804SAJJZX19JVAD0R\"]}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/instructions", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
